The role will be responsible for ensuring a smooth and memorable customer journeyfrom showroom enquiry and vehicle purchase through delivery, service follow-up, feedback, and customer retention. Develop action plans to improve customer satisfaction and loyalty. Ensure positive customer experiences are encouraged and recognised. 3. Coordinate with Sales, Service, Finance, Insurance, and OEM teams to close complaints. Maintain a complaint tracker and ensure timely closure. Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring complaints and recommend preventive actions. Escalate critical issues to senior management with appropriate recommendations. 4. Vehicle Delivery Experience Ensure every vehicle delivery provides a memorable customer experience. Coordinate with Sales and Delivery teams to ensure vehicles are ready on time. Ensure proper documentation, vehicle explanation, accessories, and delivery protocols are completed. Drive personalised delivery experiences for important customers. Monitor delivery feedback and identify areas for improvement. 5. Customer Retention & Relationship Management Develop initiatives to improve customer retention and repeat business. Maintain regular communication with existing customers. Coordinate customer engagement activities, campaigns, events, and referral programmes. Identify opportunities for repeat purchases, accessories, service visits, and referrals. Build strong relationships with key and loyal customers. 6. Team Coordination & Training Train showroom employees on customer service etiquette and customer-handling standards. Conduct regular customer experience briefings with Sales and Service teams.
